output_quality_evals.name: vague-one-liner-software-feature
output_quality_evals.prompt: we need a way for customers to cancel their subscription themselves instead of emailing support. can you write up the requirements
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Interview questions asked before any document. Should probe retention/win-back policy, refund handling, mid-cycle behavior, what the user sees after cancelling, and who approves. Document only after answers.

output_quality_evals.name: data-pipeline-with-hidden-edge-cases
output_quality_evals.prompt: Write requirements for a nightly job that pulls orders from our vendor's API into the warehouse. Vendor sends about 40k orders a day.
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Depth calibrated to standard or deep. Must surface late/duplicate/out-of-order records, re-run safety, upstream outage behavior, schema drift, retention of personal data, and downstream consumers.

output_quality_evals.name: trivial-ask-should-not-over-interview
output_quality_evals.prompt: I need requirements for adding a 'last login' column to our internal admin user list. Nothing fancy.
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Light tier declared. Three to five questions at most, then a short but complete document. Over-interviewing this is a failure.

output_quality_evals.name: requester-cannot-answer
output_quality_evals.prompt: Requirements for an internal tool that auto-approves expense reports under $50. I honestly don't know our audit rules, that's a finance thing.
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Unanswered items recorded as open questions with named owners rather than invented. Assumptions section used explicitly. Side-effecting auto-approval flagged for confirmation design.
